definitions.explanation: Successfully completing a task, mission, or goal from start to finish. Implies determination and effort in seeing something through.

examples.japanese: ⟦{任務|にんむ}→任務：05513_ninmu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{完遂|かんすい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{完遂|かんすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: It takes time to carry the plan through to completion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負|ま}け→負ける：01134_makeru⟧ず、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{完遂|かんすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important not to give in to difficulties and carry your goals through to the end.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word often used in business, military, and project contexts. Emphasizes the completion aspect more strongly than ⟦{達成|たっせい}→達成：04816_tassei⟧, which focuses on achievement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{任務|にんむ}→任務：05513_ninmu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{完遂|かんすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to accomplish a mission)
- ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{完遂|かんすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to carry out a plan)
- ⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{完遂|かんすい} (completion of a goal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{達成|たっせい}→達成：04816_tassei⟧: achievement — focuses on reaching a goal, less emphasis on the process
- ⟦{遂行|すいこう}→遂行：05619_suikou⟧: execution, carrying out — focuses on the process of performing a task
